goal: Secure Staff PWA cold-start on cafe Wi-Fi with WAN unavailable and Local healthy, without caching authenticated operational HTML or creating a second password authority.
security_invariants: cached HTML contains no LAN bearer token and no operational data
LAN credential is persisted only in secure context and expires at the earliest of LAN token, Public session and 8-hour device fence
cold-start reauthenticates Local by LAN health before runtime adapters load
installation_id and projection_id must match the persisted authenticated session identity
Local remains capability authority and revalidates projection/capabilities on every LAN request
WAN-off transport never silently falls back to unavailable Public endpoints
mutations retain durable request identity and reconcile LAN receipt before returning unknown outcome
logout/device-clear purges both persisted bootstrap credential and offline template cache
cross-origin origin migration never claims browser state migration
